claim: A game that draws figures by OR or overwrite and never reads the screen needs no staging or commit: set one sprite per object at its plot and hide it at its erase and at every screen clear.

evidence.text: Player, hens and duck (OR-drawn) become sprites 0-6 set at their plotters; five hook sites at the screen clears hide sprites 0-6 and replay the displaced instruction; no logic reads screen or attributes.
evidence.quote: e_c1..e_c5 at the five screen clears: hide sprites 0-6, replay the instruction, jump on.
